orgDesign.companyProfile: Dutch vertical-ERP SaaS company modeled on Bloxs Software B.V. (Utrecht, founded 2015) after its first add-on acquisition, Informant Software (Wateringen, standard product since 1998, acquired 7 July 2025) under majority shareholder Vortex Capital Partners (buyout announced 28 October 2024). Bloxs had about 35 employees before the acquisition; the combined company is modeled at roughly 50 people serving 5,000+ users at hundreds of real estate investors, asset managers, property managers and VvE administrators who manage 450,000+ rental units, invoice about EUR 4 billion of rent a year and hold roughly EUR 70 billion of property value on the platform. Revenue comes from per-organisation subscriptions that scale with modules and portfolio size, add-on modules (portals, API Platform, projects, VvE), implementation, data migration, training and unlimited support — the company owns no property and takes no rent. CEO André Proost (since 1 May 2025, ex CompuGroup Medical and Centric) leads; founder Dennis Gubbels is board member, shareholder and M&A director; Informant managing director Arno Mulder leads the phased integration of the Informant base.
orgDesign.operatingModel: With about 50 people the organisation stays deliberately flat: five small product groups, each led by a working product lead rather than a management layer, and twelve teams of 2-6 people who own their bricks end to end (product, build, run, second-line support). Stream-aligned teams own the real estate lifecycle Portfolio -> Let -> Contract -> Collect -> Maintain -> Account -> Report -> Serve, following the eight Bloxs modules (Relaties, Projecten, Objecten, Techniek, Contracten, Financieel, Rapportages, Portalen); a complicated-subsystem team guards multi-entity accounting, VAT and period close; two platform teams provide identity, workflow and migration tooling and the open API with certified integrations (Proprli, Huurprijscheck.app, Ziezodan, Gmail and Outlook, Power BI, banks and accounting packages); two enabling teams embed hyper automation and AI assistants into every workflow and run implementation, Informant migration, training and unlimited support. The Informant lineage staffs owners'-association management and part of customer success; the Vortex thesis (modern SaaS with unique automation, professionalise the organisation, acquire selectively) is expressed through automation-and-ai, customer-success-and-implementation and a platform-core built so acquired products plug into one tenant, identity and migration layer. Every team is steward of the data assets its bricks create, so the integrated real estate data model — object, unit, contact, contract, invoice, bank line, ticket and work order in one place — stays the company's strategic asset.
